cohort: The study included 1,771 live singleton deliveries resulting from frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles, divided into groups based on endometrial thickness (EMT <= 7.5 mm vs. EMT > 7.5 mm).
finding: Thinner endometrium was significantly associated with higher rates of placental abruption, abnormal placental cord insertion, placental adherence, postpartum haemorrhage (after adjustment), and lower birthweight/low birthweight in singleton deliveries from FET cycles.
birth_weight: lower birthweight, low birthweight (LBW), macrosomia, large for gestational age (LGA), appropriate for gestational age (AGA)
gest_age: preterm labour, large for gestational age (LGA), appropriate for gestational age (AGA)
